patterns.name: Local-Only Storage
patterns.description: v1 uses SQLite + local file storage only. No sync, no shared backend.

patterns.name: Meeting/Task Separation
patterns.description: Meeting records are separate entities from tasks. Meetings can emit task candidates.

patterns.name: AI Review Gate
patterns.description: AI extraction creates reviewable candidates, never auto-final records.

patterns.name: Import/Export Over Sync
patterns.description: Data exchange happens via versioned JSON bundles, not live sync.

patterns.name: App Shell Boundaries
patterns.description: Shell code lives in lib/app/, feature code in feature folders.

patterns.name: Home Quick Actions
patterns.description: Documented Home quick actions must map to real user-completable flows.

patterns.name: Doc Canonical Source
patterns.description: docs/ is the canonical source of truth for app design.

patterns.name: Import Graph Integrity
patterns.description: Dart import graph must not contain cycles or cross-layer violations.
